note: Baseline b62eb79 (886874a). Only change: refuse the non-fast_tail problem geometry in main() and call launch_pinning_pipeline<true> unconditionally, so the FAST_TAIL=false specialization is never instantiated. The ranked build line carries no -arch, so nvcc 12.8 targets sm_52 and the RTX 4090 JIT-compiles the embedded compute_52 PTX at runtime, inside the timed window. That JIT input drops from 1,339,274 to 670,595 bytes (-49.9%), 8 kernels to 6. No arithmetic changed: all six surviving kernels have byte-identical PTX instruction streams. NOT measured on a GPU - see the submission note.
